In Yemen,
heavy fighting
between the
Houthis
and the
Presidential Leadership Council
leaves hundreds of people dead.
American journalist and feminist activist
Gloria Steinem
(pictured)
dies at the
age of 92
.
Following
the Kazakh legislative election
,
Oljas Bektenov
is reappointed
Prime Minister of Kazakhstan
by the newly established
Kurultai
.
Duane Davis is convicted of orchestrating
the 1996 murder
of American rapper
Tupac Shakur
.

Disasters and accidents
Sinking of the ''Virgo Transport 8''
Six people die, 97 are rescued and 140 remain missing after the
sinking
of the
Virgo Transport 8
ferry
in the
Java Sea
,
Indonesia
.
(BBC)
Politics and elections
2026 Swedish general election
Swedes
vote to elect all 349 seats of the
Riksdag
. Incumbent
prime minister
Ulf Kristersson
, who seeks to lead the
Moderates
to a second consecutive government while including the
right-wing populist
Sweden Democrats
in his cabinet, is being challenged by the former prime minister and
SAP
leader
Magdalena Andersson
.
(AP)
(DW)
edit
history
watch
Armed conflicts and attacks
Middle Eastern crisis
2026 Iran war
2026 Iran war ceasefire
,
Iran–United Arab Emirates relations
Iran
and the
United Arab Emirates
sign a joint statement calling for restraint in the war. Additionally,
Iranian president
Masoud Pezeshkian
and
Abu Dhabi
ruler
Khaled bin Mohamed Al Nahyan
meet at the
BRICS summit
, the highest profile meeting between the two countries since the war started on February 28.
(
Al-Monitor
)
(
Hindustan Times
)
2026 Iranian strikes on Jordan
,
China in the 2026 Iran war
The Wall Street Journal
reports that Iran had received
Chinese
satellite images
before launching a July 17 strike on the
Muwaffaq Salti Air Base
in
Jordan
that
killed
three
United States Army
soldiers.
(AFP via
Arab News
)
Yemeni civil war
2026 Yemen offensives
,
Strait of Bab al-Mandab crisis
Yemeni
government forces
strike
Houthi
positions near the port of
Mokha
,
Taiz Governorate
, and along the Mokha–
Dhubab
road, reporting that they destroyed vehicles and weapons and killed Houthi fighters after the group captured the city.
(AFP via France 24)
Russo-Ukrainian war
Kryvyi Rih strikes
,
Odesa strikes
,
Zaporizhzhia strikes
Russian
drone strikes
across
Ukraine
kill eight
civilians
, including two people in
Zaporizhzhia
, two people at a
grocery store
in
Zhytomyr
, one person in
Kryvyi Rih
, while a "massive attack" targeting the
Port of Odesa
and surrounding areas wounds at least 28 people.
(AP)
Eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war
A
Russian drone
strikes a civilian vehicle in
Kramatorsk
,
Donetsk Oblast
, killing three people.
(AP)
Arts and culture
83rd Venice International Film Festival
May el-Toukhy
's film
Woman Unknown
wins the
Golden Lion
at the
Venice Film Festival
in
Italy
, while
Lee Chang-dong
's
Possible Love
and
Yuval Abraham
and
Rachel Szor
's
NAZA
win the competition's
Grand Jury Prize
and
Special Jury Prize
, respectively.
(
Japan Today
)
Rukidi IV
, the late
king
of
Uganda
's
Tooro Kingdom
, is buried.
(Reuters)
Disasters and accidents
MV
June Aster
ship fire
The
Philippine
coast guard
confirms that 41 more bodies have been discovered aboard the burned vessel MV
June Aster
off
Coron
,
Palawan
, bringing the death toll from the fire to 76.
(AFP via
Philippine Daily Inquirer
)
Health and environment
2026 Atlantic hurricane season
The
Atlantic hurricane season
reaches a 103-day record in the satellite era without a hurricane after the season started on June 1, the first since
1941
, with the
El Niño
in the
Pacific Ocean
being a big factor.
(CNN)
(
The New York Times
)
(
USA Today
)
International relations
North Korean missile tests
North Korea
launches a series of
SRBM
missile tests from
Wonsan
in response to trilateral Freedom Edge
military exercises
conducted by
Japan
,
South Korea
, and the
United States
.
(
Korea JoongAng Daily
)
(Reuters)
Law and crime
Cléon derailment
French
officials investigate if the
derailment
was caused by
sabotage
after a fragment of rail was found on the tracks.
(BBC News)
(RTÉ)
(France 24)
Several residents are arrested after
riots
erupted yesterday in
Kobani
,
Syria
, over the murder of a
Kurdish citizen
that was blamed on an
Arab
man. Some of those arrested starter a
prison riot
at the prison, which resulted in a fire that killed seven inmates. The violence erupted over plans to transfer some prisoners to another prison in
Aleppo
.
(AP)
Politics and elections
Protests against Donald Trump
Protests against the 2026 Iran war
,
Gaza war protests
,
Protests against the second Trump administration
Thousands of demonstrators gather in
Dublin
and
Doonbeg
,
Ireland
, against
U.S. president
Donald Trump
's
visit
to the country and protest against his role in the wars in Iran and
Gaza
.
(
Irish Times
)
(
The New York Times
)
Sports
2026 US Open
In
tennis
,
Elena Rybakina
wins the
women's singles
title at the
US Open
, her third
major
title, after defeating two-time defending champion
Aryna Sabalenka
in the final, 6–4, 5–7, 6–2.
(AFP via France 24)
Christian Harrison
and
Neal Skupski
win the
men's doubles
title at the US Open without dropping a
set
in the tournament after defeating
Kevin Krawietz
and
Tim Pütz
, 6–4, 7–6
(8–6)
in the final.
(AFP via France 24)
2026 Summer Youth Olympics
The
Olympic flame
arrives in
Dakar
,
Senegal
, ahead of the upcoming
Youth Olympic Games
, which will be the first Olympic event held in
Africa
.
(AP)
edit
history
watch
Armed conflicts and attacks
Middle Eastern crisis
Yemeni civil war
2026 Yemen offensives
Yemen
's
Houthis
seize
Perim Island
in the
Strait of Bab al-Mandab
after
government forces
withdrew, completing their takeover of the surrounding area and giving them control of territory overlooking a major
sea lane
between the
Red Sea
and
Gulf of Aden
.
(AFP via France 24)
The Houthis announces the ending and the success of its offensives, expelling government forces from six districts and seizing major locations.
(Al Jazeera)
Saudi Arabia
's
Ministry of Energy
temporarily closes the country's
East-West Crude Oil Pipeline
as a precautionary measure following multiple attacks by drones from
Iraq
on Thursday.
(CNBC)
Russo-Ukrainian war
Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war
Ukrainian drone
strikes kill two people and injure three others in
Tula Oblast
,
Russia
, while a separate strike kills a 37-year-old man in
Kursk Oblast
, according to regional officials.
(Reuters)
Kyiv strikes
,
Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war
Russian drone
strikes hit two
petrol stations
in
Kyiv
,
Ukraine
, killing two people and injuring 12 others. A separate attack on a residential building injures eight people, while another strike kills a woman in
Kyiv Oblast
.
(Reuters)
Arts and culture
Norwegian royal family
Princess Astrid
, an older sister of the
late
Norwegian King
Harald V
and daughter of
Olav V
, dies at the age of 94.
(Sky News)
Business and economy
The
Kyrgyz National Bank
reports that
Kyrgyzstan
has started domestically printing banknotes of the
Kyrgyz som
, the country's currency, for the first time since
independence
.
(24.kg)
(Kursiv)
Disasters and accidents
MV
June Aster
ship fire
The death toll from the MV
June Aster
ferry fire off
Coron
,
Palawan
,
Philippines
, rises from five to 35 after
firefighters
boarded the burned vessel and recovered 30 additional bodies. The
coast guard
continues searching for dozens of missing passengers and crew.
(Reuters)
At least 16 people are killed in a fire in a
retirement home
near
Pitrufquén
,
Chile
. Ten people are rescued and hospitalized.
(DPA via Yahoo News)
Health and environment
2026 Ebola epidemic
A case of
Ebola
is reported in the
Sud-Ubangi
province
, making it the seventh province in the
Democratic Republic of the Congo
the outbreak has spread to.
(
The Independent
)
2026 United States cyclosporiasis outbreak
The
U.S. Food and Drug Administration
and
U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
declares an end to the
cyclosporiasis
food poisoning outbreak, which is caused by
Cyclospora cayetanensis
and linked to
iceberg lettuce
from
Taylor Farms
, in the
United States
.
(CNBC)
(Reuters)
Endangerment of orangutans
,
India–Indonesia relations
Indonesia
works with
Indian
authorities to repatriate five baby
orangutans
found in an
Odisha
forest
after suspected
trafficking
.
Odisha Police
and India's
Wildlife Crime Control Bureau
examine how the apes, which are native to
Borneo
and
Sumatra
, reached India.
(AFP via France 24)
International relations
Israel–United Kingdom relations
In retaliation to
British
sanctions on
goods
from
Israeli settlements
earlier this week, the
Israeli
government
orders a team of
British soldiers
who train and advise
Palestinian Authority
security forces
in the
West Bank
to leave the country.
(
The Telegraph
)
Law and crime
The Gambia
bans protests without official permits after demonstrations over prolonged
power outages
damaged a
police
post and utility offices. Police arrest 11 people in connection with the unrest and warn that they will disperse unauthorized gatherings.
(Reuters)
A
Hong Kong
court
sentences
pro-democracy
activists
Lee Cheuk-yan
and
Chow Hang-tung
to seven years in
prison
each for
inciting subversion
under the
national security law
for leading the
Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China
.
(AFP)
(Reuters)
The
Seoul Central District Court
acquits former
South Korean
president
Yoon Suk Yeol
on charges that he appointed his
defense minister
,
Lee Jong-sup
, as ambassador to
Australia
to
obstruct an investigation
into a
South Korean marine
's drowning during
the 2023 floods
.
(AP)
South Africa
extradites six
Nigerian
nationals allegedly belonging to
Black Axe
to the
United States
, where they face
wire fraud
and
money laundering
charges linked to
online romance scams
that allegedly
defrauded
more than 100 victims.
(Reuters)
The
Lebanese Army
arrests
Suleiman Hilal Al Assad
, a
cousin
of former
Syrian president
Bashar al-Assad
, along with two other men, on
drug trafficking
charges. The men are now under the custody of the
Lebanese Defence Ministry
.
(Gulf News)
Politics and elections
September 11 intelligence before the attacks
The
U.S. Central Intelligence Agency
releases 71 documents warning of a threat from
Osama bin Laden
and
Al Qaeda
prior to the
September 11 attacks
, including
presidential daily briefs
during the administrations of former
U.S. presidents
Bill Clinton
and
George W. Bush
from 1998 to
the day after the attacks
.
(BBC)
(Al Jazeera)
edit
history
watch
Armed conflicts and attacks
Middle Eastern crisis
Yemeni civil war
2026 Yemen offensives
Houthis
capture the port city of
Mokha
, as government forces retreat from the districts of
Hays
and
Al Khawkhah
. A mass exodus of civilians from the area towards
Aden
is reported.
(AFP via France 24)
Gaza war
Aftermath of the Second Intifada
The
Israel Defense Forces
and
Shin Bet
confirm that they have killed
Hamas
senior leader Farah Hamed, a senior member who was accused of carrying out the 2003 attack that resulted in the killing of
Shalom Har-Melech
[
he
]
, the late husband of
Limor Son Har-Melech
, in a airstrike in the
Gaza Strip
.
(Israel National News)
(
The Times of Israel
)
Israeli
airstrikes on the
Gaza Strip
kill a family of four.
(Reuters)
Hezbollah–Israel conflict
2026 Lebanon war
Israeli Prime Minister
Benjamin Netanyahu
and
Defense Minister
Israel Katz
claims that the
Israeli
military has destroyed a
Hezbollah
tunnel
in
Ali al-Taher
.
(
The Financial Times
)
(Al Jazeera)
The
U.S. Geological Survey
reports that a magnitude 4.1 earthquake has been detected after Israel carried out the strike in Ali al-Taher.
(Sky News)
Russo-Ukrainian war
Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war
,
Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war
Russia
drone strikes
across
Ukraine
kill at least 15 people and injure 90 others, including victims in
Dnipro
,
Mykolaiv
,
Odesa
,
Pavlohrad
, and
Sumy
. Ukraine also strikes
gas facilities
in
Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug
,
Ural
, Russia.
(Al Jazeera)
Foreign fighters in the Russo-Ukrainian war
Amnesty International
says that
Russia
recruited
foreign nationals
for its war in Ukraine through deception, coercion, and
exploitation
, including
false job offers
and threats. The organization concludes that many such cases amount to
human trafficking
under
international law
.
(
The Eastleigh Voice
)
Multiple projectile explosives believed to originate from
Iraq
strike pumping stations along the
East–West Crude Oil Pipeline
in
Saudi Arabia
, causing a fire.
(CNN)
Business and economy
Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war
2026 Iran war fuel crisis
Crude oil
prices
in the
United States
, including from
Brent Crude
and
West Texas Intermediate
, reach
US$
100, the highest since May, amidst the country's
renewed tensions
with
Iran
.
(CNBC)
The
European Central Bank
raises its three key
interest rates
by 0.25 percentage points, lifting the
deposit rate
to 2.50%, as higher energy prices linked to the Iran war increase
inflation
pressures across the
eurozone
.
(CNBC)
The
International Monetary Fund
reports that the global growth of the global economy is on track to reach 3% in 2026 despite the war in Iran, but also cautioned that risks still remain high.
(Reuters)
Disasters and accidents
At least 20 people are killed and five others are reported missing after a fire breaks out on a
cargo ship
in
Qingdao
,
Shandong
,
China
.
(CNN)
Five people are killed and 40 others are injured after a bus carrying
Dutch
tourists
crashes between
Zernez
and
Susch
,
Switzerland
.
(AP)
Health and environment
2026 Bangladesh measles outbreak
Seven more children die from suspected
measles
in
Bangladesh
in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of deaths in the country to 1,009.
(
The Business Standard
)
Health minister
Sardar Md. Sakhawat Husain
announces that Bangladesh will resume nationwide
vaccinations
beginning on September 25 amidst the ongoing measles outbreak.
(
South Asian Herald
)
International relations
Algeria–United Arab Emirates relations
Algeria
cuts diplomatic relations with the
United Arab Emirates
, without specifying a reason.
(Reuters)
Peru–United States relations
,
War on drugs
Peruvian president
Keiko Fujimori
announces that
Peru
will join the
U.S.
-led
Shield of the Americas
coalition against
drug cartels
following a
visit
from
U.S. Secretary of State
Marco Rubio
.
(Reuters)
Law and crime
Hutch Organised Crime Gang
An
Irish
court
charges Jason Hutch, a son of alleged crime boss
Gerry Hutch
, with facilitating a
criminal organisation
, the same day he was extradited from
Spain
.
(RTÉ)
Sri Lanka
's
Supreme Court
overturns a 2019
presidential
pardon
granted to
Buddhist
monk
Galagoda Aththe Gnanasara
and orders him to serve the remainder of his six-year prison sentence for
criminally
intimidating
human rights
activist
Sandya Eknelygoda
.
(AFP via France 24)
Science and technology
The first
robotic surgical system
in
Kyrgyzstan
is introduced at the
Kyrgyz State Medical Academy
.
(Azertag)
(AKIPress)
(
Caspian Post
)
edit
history
watch
Armed conflicts and attacks
Middle Eastern crisis
Yemeni civil war
2026 Yemen offensive
,
Houthi–Saudi Arabian conflict
September 2026 Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia
Saudi Arabia
launches 32
airstrikes
in four
governorates
in
Yemen
against the
Houthis
.
(UA News)
The death toll from the
Saudi
airstrike
against a prison in
Al-Jawf Governorate
, two days ago, increases to 23 people.
(AP)
Gaza war
Aftermath of the Second Intifada
Hamas
claims that the
Israel Defense Forces
has killed Farah Hamed, a senior member who was accused of carrying out the 2003 attack that resulted in the killing of
Shalom Har-Melech
[
he
]
, the late husband of
Limor Son Har-Melech
, in a airstrike in the
Gaza Strip
.
(
The Jerusalem Post
)
(
Israel National News
)
(VINnews)
2026 Iran war
2026 Iranian strikes on Jordan
Iran
's
Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps
launch
missiles
at the
Muwaffaq Salti Air Base
in
Azraq
,
Jordan
, reporting damage to maintenance facilities, deployment areas, and
hangars
. Jordan says
its forces
have intercepted 18 Iranian missiles, following
United States strikes
that destroyed five
Iranian
oil tankers
.
(AFP via France 24)
Operation Southern Spear
United States strikes on alleged drug traffickers during Operation Southern Spear
The
United States Southern Command
's
Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere
kills three people in a strike on a alleged
narcotrafficking
drug boat in the
Caribbean Sea
.
(
Stars and Stripes
)
(SOUTHCOM)
Russo-Ukrainian war
Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war
A
Russian drone
strike hits a shopping centre in
Sumy
,
Ukraine
, killing two people and injuring 20 others.
(Reuters)
Arts and culture
Death and state funeral of Harald V
The
state funeral
of
King
Harald V
takes place at the
Oslo Cathedral
in
Oslo
,
Norway
.
(CNN)
(
The New York Times
)
The
Tooro Kingdom
in
western Uganda
selects Prince Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma, a television news anchor and editor, as its new
monarch
following the death of
Rukidi IV
last month.
(Reuters)
Disasters and accidents
MV
June Aster
ship fire
Five people are killed and 87 others are reported missing when a fire breaks out aboard a passenger ferry off
Coron
,
Palawan
,
Philippines
. The
coast guard
rescues 42 people from the vessel, which carried 117 passengers and 17 crew members.
(AFP via
The Straits Times
)
Sokolniki Suche train collision
A train collides with a truck at a
level crossing
in
Sokolniki Suche
,
Poland
, killing one person and injuring 20 others.
(TVP World)
(Xinhua)
Fourteen people are killed and eleven others are injured in an explosion at a weapons depot in
Sarmada
,
Syria
.
(AP)
Two people are killed and extensive damage is caused after an
explosion
at a
hydroelectric
power station
in
Piotta
,
Ticino
,
Switzerland
.
(Reuters)
Health and environment
2026 heat waves
2026 European heatwaves
Peninsular Spain
records
its hottest summer
since the
State Meteorological Agency
's measurements began in 1961, with an average temperature of 24.5
°C (76.1
°F) and 61
heatwave
days from June through August.
(
Arab News Pakistan
)
2026 North American heat wave
The
National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
reports that the
United States
has experienced its hottest summer on record from June to August with a 23.6
°C (74.5
°F), surpassing the
Dust Bowl
.
(Al Jazeera)
(CBS News)
The
Copernicus Climate Change Service
(C3S) reports that August 2026 is
the hottest month
globally since measurements began, with an average temperature of 16.96
°C (62.53
°F), exceeding the previous record set in July 2023.
(AP)
2026 Indonesia wildfires
The C3S reports that
wildfires
in
Kalimantan
and
Sumatra
,
Indonesia
, produced more than 19.7 million metric tons of
carbon dioxide emissions
from September 1 to 7, the world's highest total and more than one-third of global fire emissions.
(Reuters)
Sudanese cholera epidemic
The
United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs
announces that a 10-day
cholera
vaccination
campaign has been launched in
Tawila
,
North Darfur
in a effort to immunize 95,000 people in the area. Additionally, 16 deaths are reported from
cholera
in
Sudan
's
West Kordofan
state
.
(
Sudan Tribune
)
(Radio Dabanga)
(AllAfrica)
International relations
Israel–Slovenia relations
Israel
opens its first
embassy
in
Ljubljana
,
Slovenia
.
(AP)
Syria and weapons of mass destruction
The
International Atomic Energy Agency
ends its investigation into
Syria
's nuclear activities after
the new government
granted inspectors access to nuclear sites. Its board terminates a 2011 resolution that found Syria in non-compliance with
its nuclear safeguards
obligations.
(AFP via France 24)
Law and crime
Reform UK financial allegations
The
Metropolitan Police
launch a
criminal
investigation into
Reform UK
over allegations that it broke
foreign funding laws
in the
